from scipy.linalg import svdvals
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
threadpool_limits(limits=3)

def spectrum(a):
    s = svdvals(np.asarray(a, dtype=np.float64), check_finite=False)
    e = s*s
    return s, e.sum() / e[0], np.exp(-np.sum((e/e.sum()) * np.log(e/e.sum() + 1e-300)))

print("Shapes:", {k: v.shape for k, v in W.items()})
for l in range(4):
    print("\nLAYER", l)
    for name in ["ln1_w", "ln1_b", "ln2_w", "ln2_b"]:
        a = W[f"{name}.{l}"]
        print(name, "mean/std/min/max/norm",
              np.round([a.mean(), a.std(), a.min(), a.max(), np.linalg.norm(a)], 5))
    for name in ["W_q", "W_k", "W_v", "W_o", "W_fc", "W_proj"]:
        a = W[f"{name}.{l}"]
        s, sr, er = spectrum(a)
        print(name, "Frob=%.3f stable_rank=%.2f entropy_rank=%.2f" %
              (np.linalg.norm(a), sr, er),
              "singular_values[0:8]=", np.round(s[:8], 3),
              "s[32,64,128,256,-1]=", np.round(s[[32,64,128,256,-1]], 3))
    for j in range(6):
        sl = slice(64*j, 64*(j+1))
        q = W[f"W_q.{l}"][sl].astype(float)

        v = W[f"W_v.{l}"][sl].astype(float)

              "QK norm/srank/symcos", np.round([np.linalg.norm(a),sra,
                  np.sum(a*a.T)/np.sum(a*a)],3),
              "OV norm/srank/trace", np.round([np.linalg.norm(b),srb,np.trace(b)],3))
        print("  QK sv", np.round(sa[:8],3), "eig", np.round(ea[:6],3))
        print("  OV sv", np.round(sb[:8],3), "eig", np.round(eb[:6],3))

for l in range(4):

        q = W[f"W_q.{l}"][s].astype(float) * g
        k = W[f"W_k.{l}"][s].astype(float) * g
        v = W[f"W_v.{l}"][s].astype(float) * g
        q, k, v = q @ P, k @ P, v @ P
        A[l,j] = q.T @ k / 8
        B[l,j] = W[f"W_o.{l}"][:,s].astype(float) @ v

import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import svd
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
threadpool_limits(limits=3)

d=384
P=np.eye(d)-np.ones((d,d))/d
A={}; B={}; Q={}; K={}; V={}; O={}
for l in range(4):
    g=W[f"ln1_w.{l}"].astype(float)
    for j in range(6):
        sl=slice(j*64,(j+1)*64)
        Q[l,j]=(W[f"W_q.{l}"][sl].astype(float)*g)@P
        K[l,j]=(W[f"W_k.{l}"][sl].astype(float)*g)@P
        V[l,j]=(W[f"W_v.{l}"][sl].astype(float)*g)@P
        O[l,j]=W[f"W_o.{l}"][:,sl].astype(float)
        A[l,j]=Q[l,j].T@K[l,j]/8
        B[l,j]=O[l,j]@V[l,j]

def cos(a,b):
    return np.sum(a*b)/(np.linalg.norm(a)*np.linalg.norm(b)+1e-30)
def basis(a,r):
    return svd(a,full_matrices=False)[0][:,:r]

print("Within-layer QK matrix cosines:")
for l in range(4):
    print("L",l)
    print(np.round([[cos(A[l,i],A[l,j]) for j in range(6)] for i in range(6)],3))

pos=basis(np.concatenate([Q[0,3].T,K[0,3].T],axis=1),32)
vv=np.concatenate([V[0,j] for j in range(6)],axis=0)
tok=basis((vv@(np.eye(d)-pos@pos.T)).T,27)
print("\nL0 value singular values:",np.round(svd(vv,compute_uv=False)[:45],3))

    a=A[0,j]; b=B[0,j]
    print("L0H%d"%j,"QK both-pos/left-pos/right-pos/content",
          np.round([np.linalg.norm(pos.T@a@pos)/np.linalg.norm(a),
                    np.linalg.norm(pos.T@a)/np.linalg.norm(a),
                    np.linalg.norm(a@pos)/np.linalg.norm(a),
                    np.linalg.norm(tok.T@a@tok)/np.linalg.norm(a)],3),
          "OV source-pos/source-content",
          np.round([np.linalg.norm(b@pos)/np.linalg.norm(b),
                    np.linalg.norm(b@tok)/np.linalg.norm(b)],3))

for i in range(4):
    z=vt5[i]
    print(i,round(np.linalg.norm(pos.T@z)**2,4),round(np.linalg.norm(tok.T@z)**2,4))

    for j in range(6):
        a=A[l,j]
        qbias=W[f"W_q.{l}"][j*64:(j+1)*64].astype(float)@W[f"ln1_b.{l}"].astype(float)
        key_bias_direction=qbias@K[l,j]/8
        print("L%dH%d"%(l,j),
              "QK left/right/both fractions",np.round([
                  np.linalg.norm(out5.T@a)/np.linalg.norm(a),
                  np.linalg.norm(a@out5)/np.linalg.norm(a),
                  np.linalg.norm(out5.T@a@out5)/np.linalg.norm(a)],3),
              "bias-key norm",round(np.linalg.norm(key_bias_direction),3),
              "bias-key projection",np.round(key_bias_direction@out5,3))

print("\nMLP output spectra, positions 15..34:")
for l in range(4):
    print(l,np.round(svd(W[f"W_proj.{l}"].astype(float),compute_uv=False)[15:35],3))

print("\nL3H3 compositional diagnostics in candidate content subspace:")
for j in range(6):
    c=tok.T@A[3,j]@B[0,3]@tok
    s=svd(c,compute_uv=False)
    e=np.linalg.eigvalsh((c+c.T)/2)
    print("L3H%d"%j,"trace/nuclear=%.4f symcos=%.4f positive_symmetric_mass=%.4f"%
          (np.trace(c)/s.sum(),cos(c,c.T),e[e>0].sum()/np.abs(e).sum()),
          "top sv",np.round(s[:5],4))

import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import svd, eigh
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
threadpool_limits(limits=3)
d=384
P=np.eye(d)-np.ones((d,d))/d
g=W["ln1_w.0"].astype(float)
q=(W["W_q.0"][192:256].astype(float)*g)@P
k=(W["W_k.0"][192:256].astype(float)*g)@P
pos=svd(np.concatenate([q.T,k.T],axis=1),full_matrices=False)[0][:,:32]
vv=(W["W_v.0"].astype(float)*g)@P
ut,st,_=svd((vv@(np.eye(d)-pos@pos.T)).T,full_matrices=False)
T=ut[:,:27]
B=W["W_o.0"][:,192:256].astype(float)@vv[192:256]
F=(W["W_fc.0"].astype(float)*W["ln2_w.0"].astype(float))@P
X=F@T
Y=F@B@T

print("Candidate content singular values, first 45:",np.round(st[:45],4))
print("L0H3 OV restricted to candidate content, singular values:",
      np.round(svd(B@T,compute_uv=False),4))

def invsqrt(a):
    e,u=eigh(a)
    return (u*(np.maximum(e,1e-8)**-.5))@u.T

C=invsqrt(X.T@X)@(X.T@Y)@invsqrt(Y.T@Y)
e=np.linalg.eigvals(C)
e=e[np.argsort(-np.abs(e))]
print("\nAlgebraic current/shifted-feature cross-Gram:")
print("canonical singular values",np.round(svd(C,compute_uv=False),4))
print("eigenvalues",np.round(e,4))
print("symmetric-part eigenvalues",np.round(np.linalg.eigvalsh((C+C.T)/2),4))

datasets={"L0_FC_content":X}
u,s,vt=svd(W["W_proj.3"].astype(float),full_matrices=False)
datasets["L3_proj_output_coordinates"]=(s[:27,None]*vt[:27]).T
datasets["L3_proj_whitened_coordinates"]=vt[:27].T

for name,z in datasets.items():
    z=z-z.mean(0)
    z=z/(np.linalg.norm(z,axis=1,keepdims=True)+1e-12)
    print("\nCLUSTERING",name)
    for n in [16,20,22,24,26,28,32,40]:
        km=KMeans(n_clusters=n,n_init=8,random_state=123,max_iter=400).fit(z)
        centers=km.cluster_centers_
        centers/=np.linalg.norm(centers,axis=1,keepdims=True)
        c=np.sum(z*centers[km.labels_],axis=1)
        counts=np.bincount(km.labels_,minlength=n)
        sil=silhouette_score(z,km.labels_,sample_size=1000,random_state=123)
        print(n,"mean_cos=%.3f silhouette=%.3f"%(c.mean(),sil),
              "counts",sorted(counts.tolist(),reverse=True))
        if n==28:
            print("assigned cosine quantiles",np.round(np.quantile(c,[0,.1,.25,.5,.75,.9,1]),3))
            cc=centers@centers.T
            np.fill_diagonal(cc,-2)
            print("nearest-center cosines",np.round(np.sort(cc.max(1)),3))

from scipy.linalg import svd

d=384

g=W["ln1_w.0"].astype(float)

for j in range(6):
    s=svd(W["W_v.0"][64*j:64*(j+1)].astype(float),compute_uv=False)
    print("L0H%d"%j,np.round(s[:40],3))

print("\nRaw L0H3 OV singular values:")
ov3=W["W_o.0"][:,192:256].astype(float)@W["W_v.0"][192:256].astype(float)
print(np.round(svd(ov3,compute_uv=False)[:45],3))

rawpos=svd(np.concatenate([W["W_q.0"][192:256].T,
                          W["W_k.0"][192:256].T],axis=1).astype(float),
           full_matrices=False)[0][:,:32]
v3=W["W_v.0"][192:256].astype(float)
_,sv,tv=svd(v3@(np.eye(d)-rawpos@rawpos.T),full_matrices=False)
print("\nRaw positional-subspace-removed L0H3 V spectrum:",np.round(sv[:40],3))

print("\nCosines of raw first-layer OV matrices:")
ovs=[]
for j in range(6):
    ovs.append(W["W_o.0"][:,j*64:(j+1)*64].astype(float)@
               W["W_v.0"][j*64:(j+1)*64].astype(float))
print(np.round([[np.sum(x*y)/(np.linalg.norm(x)*np.linalg.norm(y)) for y in ovs] for x in ovs],3))

F=(W["W_fc.0"].astype(float)*W["ln2_w.0"].astype(float))@P
for rank in [20,23,26]:
    # Map weight-derived directions from the first normalization's coordinate
    # system back to residual coordinates; no layer is evaluated.
    T=tv[:rank].T/np.maximum(g[:,None],.08)
    T=np.linalg.qr(P@T)[0]
    z=F@T
    z-=z.mean(0)
    z/=np.linalg.norm(z,axis=1,keepdims=True)+1e-12
    km=KMeans(n_clusters=28,n_init=20,random_state=123,max_iter=500).fit(z)
    cen=km.cluster_centers_
    cen/=np.linalg.norm(cen,axis=1,keepdims=True)
    cc=cen@cen.T
    np.fill_diagonal(cc,-2)

import numpy as np

# A purely parameter-level check: does recognizable initialization noise

       99,100,101,123,124,256,314,420,512,666,777,999,1024,1234,1337,
       1729,2023,2024,2025,2026,2718,3141,3407,4096,12345,31415,54321]
target=W["W_q.0"][320:324].astype(np.float64)

    gen=torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(seed)
    a=torch.randn((nrows,384),generator=gen,dtype=torch.float32).numpy()

            records.append((float(scores[i]),seed,int(i),consecutive.tolist()))
